req.title: Reject wrong method on /post
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than POST on /post.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /post must return HTTP 405 for any method other than POST. Tests cover: (1) positive path — POST returns 200 with expected JSON keys; (2) negative paths — GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE each return exactly 405; (3) boundary — HEAD and OPTIONS (edge-case methods) also return 405. The violation was test[7]: kind=negative with heuristic=EP is invalid because EP is a partitioning heuristic used for positive equivalence classes. Fixed by changing heuristic to NEG for that negative test, which correctly classifies the equivalence partition of all disallowed methods as a negative test using NEG heuristic.

tests.name: test_post_method_returns_200_with_expected_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send HTTP POST to /post with no body
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-005: POST is the only allowed method; it must succeed with 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
r = client.post('/post')
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.get_json()
assert isinstance(body, dict)
for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
    assert key in body

tests.name: test_post_returns_200_not_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert status is exactly 200 and NOT 405
trace: R-HTTPBIN-005: Boundary between allowed (POST=200) and disallowed (other=405); both sides of the boundary must be verified
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
r = client.post('/post')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert r.status_code != 405
body = r.get_json()
assert body is not None

tests.name: test_all_non_post_methods_return_exactly_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE to /post in a loop
trace: R-HTTPBIN-005: Negative equivalence partition — all non-POST methods belong to the 'rejected' class returning 405
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
methods = [
    client.get,
    client.put,
    client.patch,
    client.delete,
]
for method_fn in methods:
    r = method_fn('/post')
    assert r.status_code == 405, (
        f"Expected 405 but got {r.status_code} for {method_fn}"
    )
